### 2026-10-23 – I made the final wiring updates and reviewed my code. Many jumper wires were loose, so i had to fasten them at odd angles to fasten to my ESP32. I wasn't sure which leg was the anode of one LED, since

**5h**

I made the final wiring updates and reviewed my code. Many jumper wires were loose, so i had to fasten them at odd angles to fasten to my ESP32. I wasn't sure which leg was the anode of one LED, since both legs were the same length. When it was completely done, I tried it, but it didn't work. I checked my wiring and realised that the switch was off and its wire was loose. I fixed it then.
